title: CurseCore Field: Integrations
summary: Connect CurseCore to RitualCore, Arcane Index, Grimoire, Lens, RelicTech, SpellCore, and missions.

blocks.title: Connected Systems
blocks.body: RitualCore cleanses minor curses, Arcane Index explains records, Grimoire warns about consequences, Lens scans live state, and MissionCore tracks gains and cleanses.

blocks.title: Practical Pairings
blocks.body: Use diagnostics before rituals, Index before risky items, Grimoire before forbidden choices, and RelicTech warnings when corruption flags appear.

blocks.title: Fallback Play
blocks.body: If a bridge is absent, keep curse state server-side and visible through the simplest diagnostic path available.

blocks.title: Fallback Check
blocks.body: If the helper addon is absent, keep the same order by hand and follow the manual checkpoint.
